entries.title: Crewmates write tests that can fail
entries.body: Crewmates no longer write tests that pass whatever the code does: a test states its expected value apart from the code it checks, asserts what that code did rather than what a stand-in was set to return, and makes at least one assertion. Before the merge card, a crewmate runs each test it adds or edits once against broken code and reports seeing it fail, and every independent review flags a test that cannot fail. A project's own rule on tests still wins, and turning off Testing rules in Settings → Runbooks turns these rules off too.
entries.noPicture: This changes the guidance crewmates and reviewers follow, not a view or control.
